REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JULY 23, 2020 -
07:00 P.M.
TELECONFERENCE MEETING AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20 VIA ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID #841 5091 2119
*COVID-19 NOTICE*
To protect public health and safety during the local, state, and federally declared COVID-19 emergency, the City Council Chamber and City Hall are closed to the public. Consistent with State of California Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the Los Angeles County Health Officer’s “Safer at Home Order for Control of COVID-19” the City Council will participate in the meeting through teleconference. Public participation in the meeting will be facilitated through the electronic methods as described below.
Agenda Materials:
The agenda and agenda packet related to items on this agenda are available for public inspection at www.cerritos.us. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet will be made available for public inspection at www.cerritos.us.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION:
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us and on Cerritos TV3.
Public Comments:
Members of the public may provide public comment through the following methods:
Email: Members of the public may provide public comment by submitting an email to city_clerk@cerritos.us by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the meeting date and agenda item number for which you would like to provide comment in the subject line of the email. The public comment will be distributed to all members of the City Council. During the meeting your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Teleconference Participation: You may provide audio public comment by connecting to the teleconference meeting online or by telephone/mobile call (please select only one method). Public speakers will be queued to provide comment at the appropriate time on the agenda. You must be available to provide comment at the time you are called upon to speak. If you are not planning on providing public comment we encourage you to observe the meeting via livestream or on Cerritos TV3 to allow staff to more effectively manage the number of teleconference connections.
Cerritos Zoom meeting online link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/84150912119
Cerritos Zoom Meeting call-in telephone number: (669) 900-6833
Cerritos Zoom Meeting ID: 841 5091 2119
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations:
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the teleconference meeting.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
THURSDAY, JULY 23, 2020, 7:00 P.M., TELECONFERENCED MEETING AUTHORIZED BY
STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20, VIA ZOOM VIDEO
COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID# 841 5091 2119

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Naresh Solanki.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Bruce Barrows
  Council/Agency Member Grace Hu
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Chuong Vo
  Mayor/Chair Naresh Solanki

5.  Presentations/Appointments

  CLOSED SESSION REPORT

  City Attorney Mark Steres provided the following report from the Closed Session
  conducted as part of the July 9, 2020 City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting:

  As part of the July 9, 2020 Regular Meeting, the City Council met in Closed Session to
  discuss Items 12D and 12E as listed on that meeting’s agenda (Items are listed below
  for reference). The City Attorney was unable to report out of that Closed Session
  because the meeting was conducted by teleconference. The City Council received an
  update on Items 12D and 12E from the City’s labor negotiators and provided direction
  to them. No reportable action was taken and there was nothing further to report.

  12D. CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957.6 (COUNCIL)
  Agency Negotiators: Art Gallucci, Patricia Leyva, and Charles Goldstein
  Employee Organization: AFSCME, Local 619

  12E.  CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957.6 (COUNCIL)
  Agency Negotiators: Art Gallucci and Charles Goldstein
  Unrepresented Employees: Full-Time Exempt

  This concluded the City Attorney’s Closed Session report.
 City of Cerritos  July 23, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 6

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  provided written correspondence or elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period closed.

7.  Consent Calendar

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of July 9, 2020
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Hu, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of July 9, 2020
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands

7B.1. Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated July 23, 2020
  (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Hu, to approve the Register of
  Demands, as follows:

  City of Cerritos  7/23/2020  $3,681,139.01 (COUNCIL)

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7C.  Adoption of Ordinance

  Ordinance introduced at the regular meeting of July 9, 2020

  Waive full reading of and adopt Ordinance No. 1033, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF
  CERRITOS REPEALING CHAPTER 2.22 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE, THEREBY
  DISSOLVING THE CITY OF CERRITOS ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
  (COUNCIL).

  Waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  CERRITOS REPEALING RESOLUTION 2004-10 RELATED TO ORGANIZATION,
  MEMBERSHIP AND DUTIES OF THE ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
  (COUNCIL).
 City of Cerritos  July 23, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 6

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7C.  (continued)

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Hu, to waive full reading and
  adopt:

  1. Ordinance No. 1033, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
  REPEALING CHAPTER 2.22 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE, THEREBY
  DISSOLVING THE CITY OF CERRITOS ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT
  COMMISSION (COUNCIL); and

  2. Resolution No. 2020-17, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF CERRITOS REPEALING RESOLUTION 2004-10 RELATED TO
  ORGANIZATION, MEMBERSHIP AND DUTIES OF THE ECONOMIC
  DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

  None.

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of an informational update on the City’s response to the
  COVID-19 local emergency (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Annie Hylton, City & Theater Marketing Manager/City
  Librarian. A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  provided written correspondence or elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period closed.

  There was no further action taken on this item.

9B.  Review and consideration of award of a contract for 166th Street improvements from
  Carmenita Road to Bloomfield Avenue, Federal Project No. STPL-5325 (018), Project
  No. 13065, Bid No. 1402-20 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Dario Simoes, Assistant City Engineer. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  provided written correspondence or elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period closed.
 City of Cerritos  July 23, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 4 of 6

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9B.  (continued)

  MOTION: It was moved by Hu, and seconded by Vo, to:

  1. Award a contract in the amount of $867,000 for 166th Street Rehabilitation (total
  bid), Federal Project No. STPL-5325 (018), Project No. 13065, Bid No. 1402-20, to
  Onyx Paving Company, Inc., and reject the other bids; and

  2. Authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute any project-related change
  orders (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9C.  Review and consideration of award of a contract for construction management and
  inspection services, Project No. 13065, Federal Project No. STPL-5325 (018), RFP No.
  1401-20 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Dario Simoes, Assistant City Engineer. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  provided written correspondence or elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Vo, to:

  1. Award a professional services contract in the amount of $83,750 for construction
  management and inspection services, Project No. 13065, Federal Project No. STPL-
  5325 (018), RFP No. 1401-20, to PPM Group, Inc., and reject the other proposals;
  and

  2. Authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute any contract modifications
  that may be necessary to complete the specified scope of work (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation.

  None.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or
  Federal legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.
 City of Cerritos  July 23, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 5 of 6

10.  Legislative Items (continued)

10B.1 Review and consideration of pending state legislation relating to housing including
  AB 1279 (Bloom), AB 1484 (Grayson), AB 2345 (Gonzalez), AB 3107 (Bloom), SB
  899 (Wiener), SB 1085 (Skinner), SB 1120 (Atkins), and SB 1385 (Caballero)
  (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kathy Matsumoto, Assistant City Manager. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  provided written correspondence or elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Hu, to:

  1. Direct the City Manager’s staff to prepare letters of City opposition to pending
  legislation related to housing as a matter of protecting local control, specifically: AB
  1279 (Bloom), AB 1484 (Grayson), AB 2345 (Gonzalez), AB 3107 (Bloom), SB 899
  (Wiener), SB 1085 (Skinner), SB 1120 (Atkins), and SB 1385 (Caballero) and to
  send the letters to the respective authors of the specific legislation and policy
  committees, with copies to Senator Archuleta, Assembly member Cristina Garcia
  and the professional organizations of which the City of Cerritos is a member
  (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

11.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings

  Reports were provided by Councilmember Barrows, Mayor Pro Tem Vo, and Mayor
  Solanki.

  Mayor Solanki congratulated Cerritos residents Marty and Gail Grossman in honor of
  their 50th wedding anniversary.

12.  Closed Session

  The Mayor announced the City Council would not recess to Closed Session. The items
  listed on the Closed Session agenda will be continued to the next scheduled City
  Council/Successor Agency meeting.

12A.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Manager

12B.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Attorney
 City of Cerritos  July 23, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 6 of 6

12.  Closed Session (continued)

12C.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Clerk/Treasurer

12D. CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957.6 (COUNCIL)
  Agency Negotiators: Art Gallucci, Patricia Leyva, and Charles Goldstein
  Employee Organization: AFSCME, Local 619

12E.  CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957.6 (COUNCIL)
  Agency Negotiators: Art Gallucci and Charles Goldstein
  Unrepresented Employees: Full-Time Exempt

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 8:09 p.m.
